description: Generate a Playwright regression test from a classified report using your project LLM key, then open a draft GitHub PR with the spec. Requires the inventory_v2 plan plus GitHub and LLM keys configured. Returns { prUrl, prNumber, branch, path }. Write; consumes LLM budget; NOT idempotent — each call opens a new PR. Use to lock in a regression as an E2E test; use generate_tdd_from_story to build a test from a mapped user story instead.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to configured project (`project_id` is accepted too.)

reportId.description: Report UUID to turn into a Playwright PR (`report_id` is accepted too.)

name: test_gen_from_report
title: Generate Playwright test from report
